name_en: Hittsumi — hand-torn wheat dough simmered with chicken and root vegetables
summary_ja: 小麦粉をこねて寝かせた生地を手でちぎり、鶏肉や根菜のだしで煮込む。「ひっつみ汁」とも呼ばれ、冷害で米が実りにくい北上川流域で発達した粉物文化を代表する料理として県内全域で作られる。
summary_en: Hand-torn pieces of rested wheat dough are simmered in a chicken-and-root-vegetable broth — also called hittsumi-jiru, the signature dish of the Kitakami river valley's flour-based food culture, made across Iwate.
source_title: ひっつみ／ひっつみ汁 岩手県

name_en: Mamebu jiru — a soy broth with walnut-filled wheat dumplings
summary_ja: 煮干しと昆布のだしに、根菜や焼き豆腐、くるみを包んだ小麦粉団子「まめぶ」を入れて醤油味で煮込む。凶作が続いた久慈市山形町で麺の代用として生まれたと伝わり、冠婚葬祭の行事食となっている。
summary_en: Wheat dumplings stuffed with walnut are simmered in a soy-flavored dried sardine and kelp broth with root vegetables and grilled tofu — said to have begun as a noodle substitute in famine-prone Kuji, now a dish for weddings and funerals.

name_en: Yanagi batto — willow-leaf-shaped buckwheat dumplings in a savory broth
summary_ja: そば粉をこねて柳の葉形に整え、大根やにんじん、きのこを入れた醤油味やみそ味の汁で煮る。南部藩が細切りそばを禁じた時代に「これはそばではない」と言い抜けて食べたのが名の由来とされる県北の料理。
summary_en: Buckwheat dough shaped like willow leaves is simmered in a soy- or miso-flavored broth with daikon, carrot and mushroom — said to be named for a loophole villagers used to keep eating soba after the Nanbu domain banned finely cut noodles.

name_en: Imo no ko jiru — a taro, chicken and root vegetable soup shared outdoors in autumn
summary_ja: 秋に旬を迎えるさといもを鶏肉や豆腐、大根、にんじんとともに醤油味で煮込む。さといも栽培に適した北上川流域の秋の味覚で、川岸に集まって鍋を囲む「芋煮会」が今も北上市二子地区で受け継がれている。
summary_en: Autumn taro is simmered with chicken, tofu, daikon and carrot in a soy broth — a fall favorite of the taro-growing Kitakami river valley, still enjoyed at riverside "imoni-kai" gatherings around Kitakami's Futako district.
source_title: いもの子汁 岩手県

name_en: Sanma surimi jiru — a soup of hand-ground Pacific saury fish balls
summary_ja: おろしたさんまをすり鉢でよくすって味噌や卵で味付けし、団子にして大根やねぎ、豆腐と煮込む。本州一のさんま水揚げを誇る岩手の三陸沿岸で、漁獲が増えた約60年前から定番の家庭料理となった。
summary_en: Ground Pacific saury, worked in a mortar with miso and egg, is shaped into balls and simmered with daikon, scallion and tofu — a Sanriku coast staple that took hold about 60 years ago as saury catches grew, in a region that leads Honshu in landings.
source_title: さんまのすり身汁 岩手県

name_en: Donko jiru — a miso soup of a mild-fleshed rock cod, valued for its rich liver
summary_ja: 三陸沿岸で獲れる白身魚「どんこ」のぶつ切りと肝を大根やじゃがいもとともに味噌仕立てで煮込む。冬に脂がのる魚で、恵比寿講には尾頭付きで神前に供え豊漁を祈る習わしが気仙地方に残る。
summary_en: Chunks of donko — a mild Sanriku rock cod prized for its rich liver — are simmered in miso with daikon and potato — fattiest in winter, and still offered whole at a fall Ebisu rite in the Kesen area to pray for a good catch.

name_en: Iwate-style kenchin jiru — root vegetables and crumbled tofu fried before simmering
summary_ja: にんじんや大根、ごぼうと硬めの豆腐を油でそぼろ状に炒めてから醤油だしで煮込む。発祥とされる神奈川など各地に伝わるけんちん汁だが、岩手では肉を使わず豆腐をよく炒めるのが特徴で、小正月の女性への労いに大量に作られた。
summary_en: Carrot, daikon and burdock are fried with crumbled firm tofu until it turns granular, then simmered in soy dashi — kenchin jiru is made in several regions, but Iwate's version skips meat and fries the tofu hard, once made in bulk to spare women's labor at the Little New Year.
source_title: けんちん汁 岩手県

name_en: Kurumi zoni — New Year mochi soup served alongside a sweet walnut dipping sauce
summary_ja: 大根や人参、焼き豆腐を醤油だしで煮た雑煮に焼き餅を入れ、汁ごと食べるほか、別皿のくるみだれにつけて味を変えて楽しむ。米が育ちにくい沿岸部で餅を大切に味わう工夫として、宮古地方の正月に受け継がれる。
summary_en: Grilled mochi sits in a soy-dashi zoni of daikon, carrot and grilled tofu, eaten both straight from the bowl and dipped in a separate sweet walnut sauce for a second flavor — a way of savoring scarce rice cake on the New Year table around Miyako.
source_title: くるみ雑煮 岩手県

name_en: Nuppei jiru — a thickened tofu and mushroom soup for Buddhist observances
summary_ja: 豆腐と干ししいたけ、ねぎを醤油味の汁で煮て、すりおろした長芋でとろみをつける。片栗粉でとろみをつける同系の「八杯汁」もあり、県全域で冠婚葬祭や法事の精進料理として作られてきた。
summary_en: Tofu, dried shiitake and scallion are simmered in a soy broth thickened with grated mountain yam — a close relative of "hachihai-jiru," which uses potato starch instead, made statewide as a Buddhist meat-free dish for rites and ceremonies.
source_title: ぬっぺい汁／八杯汁 岩手県
